identity.memory_query_semantics: SMI physical UUID/rounded memory separate from torch logical cuda:0/properties. Do not demand byte equality between the two interfaces; require one visible logical device mapped via the fixed UUID and record torch capacity.

before_write: Reverify current hostname/GPU UUID/driver, original binaries/tools and resource budgets
Verify upload archive+sidecars and all new targets absent, no overwrite or symlink ancestors
Verify315 exact training payload hashes before model construction; no development or confirmation reads
before_launch: Repeat current resource/installed hashes/fixed tmux absent; one claim; failure stop, no retry or resume
